text:
I can know pretty quickly that I want to be with somebody. That tells me a lot less about whether I should raise children with her, share a house for twenty years, or build the rest of my life around her. A wonderful lover can still be a terrible long-term partner. One thing I try to catch is when “I’m taking a chance on this person” turns into “this is the right person” without any new evidence.

And being loved doesn’t mean I’m finished with my own inner practices. If I stop reparenting myself and regulating myself because she’s doing enough of it for me, I’ve made the relationship carry something it shouldn’t have to carry.
